description: Run a LogQL query against Grafana Loki and return matching log entries. Results are post-processed (keyword filter, secret filtering, head/tail) and rendered in the requested format.

direction.description: Query direction sent to Loki: "backward" (newest first, default) or "forward" (oldest first).

end.description: End of the query window. Same formats as start. Default: now.

filter.description: Optional local substring filter applied to each log line before head/tail limiting.

filter_case_sensitive.description: When true, the local substring filter is case-sensitive (default: false).

format.description: Output format: "raw" (one line per entry, default), "json" (Loki API-shaped streams response), or "text" (human-readable grouped listing).

head.description: After filtering, keep only the N oldest matching entries (by timestamp) and render them newest-first. Cannot be used with tail.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries requested from Loki before local post-processing (default: 100). Use head/tail to limit after filtering.

org.description: Organization/tenant ID for the query, sent as X-Scope-OrgID (env: LOKI_ORG_ID)

start.description: Start of the query window. Accepts "now", negative durations like "-1h" or "-30m", RFC3339, or "2006-01-02T15:04:05" / "2006-01-02 15:04:05" / "2006-01-02" (parsed as UTC). Default: 1h ago.

tail.description: After filtering, keep only the N newest matching entries and render them newest-first. Cannot be used with head.

name: loki_query
